answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Reaching the nadir of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The canyon holds work receipts rather than names, so the ripple of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
